body_es: Un product roadmap es una visión compartida de la dirección del producto que comunica qué se construirá, cuándo y por qué, sin comprometerse a fechas específicas inflexibles. Existen roadmaps orientados a características, resultados (OKRs) y temas, cada uno enfatizando diferentes aspectos. La gestión de stakeholders implica mantener a ejecutivos, clientes y equipos informados y alineados, recopilar su retroalimentación y gestionar expectativas conflictivas. El Product Owner debe comunicar regularmente el roadmap, explicar cambios de prioridad con transparencia, y equilibrar demandas conflictivas con la estrategia del producto.
body_en: A product roadmap is a shared vision of product direction that communicates what will be built, when, and why, without committing to rigid specific dates. Roadmaps can be feature-oriented, outcomes-oriented (OKRs), or theme-oriented, each emphasizing different aspects. Stakeholder management involves keeping executives, customers, and teams informed and aligned, gathering feedback, and managing conflicting expectations. The Product Owner must regularly communicate the roadmap, explain priority changes transparently, and balance conflicting demands with product strategy.
example_code:
# Product Roadmap and Stakeholder Management (YAML)
roadmap:
  type: "Outcome-based Roadmap (OKRs)"
  quarterly_view: true
  
  q3_2026:
    objective: "Increase user engagement"
    key_results:
      - "Increase daily active users by 50%"
      - "Improve user retention to 45%"
    features_planned:
      - "Notification system (Priority 1)"
      - "Social sharing features (Priority 2)"
    risks: "Team capacity constraints"
  
  q4_2026:
    objective: "Enable enterprise adoption"
    key_results:
      - "Acquire 5 enterprise customers"
      - "Support team-based workflows"
    features_planned:
      - "SSO integration (Priority 1)"
      - "Advanced permissions (Priority 2)"
    risks: "Security audit delays"
  
  q1_2027:
    objective: "Monetization and scale"
    key_results:
      - "Launch subscription model"
      - "Achieve $1M ARR"
    features_planned:
      - "Payment processing"
      - "Usage-based analytics"

stakeholder_management:
  executive_communication:
    frequency: "Monthly business reviews"
    focus: "OKRs and revenue impact"
  
  customer_feedback:
    channels: ["User interviews", "Surveys", "Support tickets"]
    integration: "Inform quarterly planning"
  
  team_alignment:
    frequency: "Sprint planning"
    transparency: "Why this work matters to the roadmap"
  
  expectation_management:
    approach: "Deliver what's planned, communicate changes early"
    cadence: "Updates when priority changes occur"
